review_comments.body:
**[P1] Handle the missing MCP v1 symbol in the test fallback**

With the committed MCP 2.2.0 dependency, `make lint` fails with `Module "mcp.shared.exceptions" has no attribute "McpError" [attr-defined]`. Mypy checks this fallback even though it is not executed, and `ignore[no-redef]` does not cover that diagnostic. Handle the v1-only symbol as the production fallback does so the required lint gate passes ([AGENTS.md:93](https://github.com/temporalio/ai-integrations/blob/ff02b413cdcc4c9d0f5f8993fa643e6a8e226f21/AGENTS.md#L93)).

comments.body:
Added the missing `attr-defined` suppression to the MCP v1 fallback import in the test, matching the production fallback, and renamed unused test-double parameters. `make lint` and all 71 selected MCP tests pass.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
